_comment: REQ-0144 moderation-gate registry. SINGLE SOURCE of gate identity/version/thresholds and model provenance for the UGC skin moderation pipeline (tools/moderation_gate.py). Mirrors the inspect_kits.json convention. Bump a gate_version on any threshold or algorithm change. LLMs draft; scripts judge -- no LLM verdict anywhere in this pipeline.

gates.note: Gate 0 = the REQ-0126 S3 machine gate (seams, clip-mask leakage, shape suite), reused AS-IS and already a standalone ci step. Per-bitmap technical validation binds to this harness once a UGC skin-def ingestion format exists (an explicit non-goal here); the pipeline records PASS/REJECT when run with --technical=run, else DELEGATED (an attestation of the committed harness golden).

gates.policy: p_nsfw >= reject_p_nsfw -> REJECT; escalate_p_nsfw <= p_nsfw < reject_p_nsfw -> ESCALATE (human operator); p_nsfw < escalate_p_nsfw -> PASS. A classifier that cannot run = ESCALATE (fail-safe; never fail-open to PASS).
gates.csam_note: A local image classifier CANNOT certify the ABSENCE of CSAM. Gate 1 is an NSFW filter, not a CSAM detector. Operational policy: NSFW gate + MANDATORY human-operator escalation on every REJECT/ESCALATE, and reporting to authorities per jurisdiction on any suspected CSAM. No CSAM-specific model is trained or shipped and no CSAM material is sourced (test fixtures are benign procedural images only). This is a documented limit, not a solved problem.

gates.method: 64-bit DCT perceptual hash (tools/moderation_phash.py); Hamming distance <= per-entry max_hamming -> REJECT.
gates.logo_detector: NOT SHIPPED. A general logo/brand detector needs trained weights (e.g. an ONNX YOLO-logo net); no sound torch-free local option is vetted in this stack (onnxruntime is present but there are no trustworthy logo-detection weights on hand). Recorded as a known limit; a future detector plugs in behind this same Gate-2 interface. The pHash denylist is the shipped best-effort mechanism.
gates.limits: pHash catches near-duplicate reproductions of denylisted marks, NOT stylistic homage, small crops, heavy recolors, or novel infringing art. Best-effort by design; the denylist is operator-curated and intentionally sparse.
